outline:
應用單元操作的原理與知識，使學生從實際操作中瞭解各種單元操
作設備的操作及性能。
The course provides facilities for students to apply theoretical and fundamental knowledge of unit operations. In such an environment, much emphasis is placed upon the operation and performance of various experimental units.
schedule:
Exp.1 配管(一)
Exp.2 配管(二)
Exp.3 液體黏度的測定
Exp.4 雷諾數之測定
Exp.5 離心幫浦特性實驗
Exp.6 堰
Exp.7 攪拌動力測定
Exp.8 篩析
Exp.9 流體流動摩擦

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查(Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
